findings.title: Account UI message switched to Java MessageFormat placeholders
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from i18next placeholders ({{0}}, {{1}}, {{2}}) to Java MessageFormat ({0} and a {2,choice,...} pattern). Every other string in this account-ui bundle still uses {{0}}-style interpolation. The account UI will not substitute the attribute name or limits, and users will see the raw choice-format pattern, including the '<' selector, instead of a readable validation error.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched to Java MessageFormat placeholders
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size in the React admin console bundle was changed from {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} to a Java MessageFormat choice pattern. This bundle is not formatted with java.text.MessageFormat; the admin UI will show the literal '{0}' and '{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}' text instead of the attribute name and value counts.

findings.title: Diff highlighter throws when prefix and suffix overlap
findings.body: When sanitized and original differ, the report trims a shared prefix and suffix and then calls substring(start, length - end) with no check that start <= length - end. If the common prefix and suffix overlap (for example original 'aaa' vs sanitized 'aa'), length - end is less than start and String.substring throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. verify() does not catch RuntimeException, so one illegal message aborts the whole theme-verifier run instead of reporting the violation.

findings.title: Message bundles are decoded as ISO-8859-1
findings.body: verifySafeHtml loads files with PropertyResourceBundle(InputStream), which always decodes as ISO-8859-1. Keycloak theme message files are UTF-8 (the same files contain raw Chinese, Arabic, and other non-Latin text). The sanitizer therefore runs on mojibake, not the strings that are shipped, so it can fail the build on legitimate translations or miss HTML that only differs after a UTF-8 decode. Use a UTF-8 Reader (PropertyResourceBundle(Reader) or an InputStreamReader).

findings.title: Lithuanian login string replaced with Italian
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 in the Lithuanian login bundle was replaced with 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:' which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Users with locale lt will see an Italian TOTP setup instruction.

findings.title: Lithuanian account string replaced with Italian
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account bundle was replaced with the same Italian sentence ('Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:'). The previous Lithuanian text was removed, so the account theme shows the wrong language for this step.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese account string written in Traditional Chinese
findings.body: totpStep1 in messages_zh_CN.properties was replaced with '在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：', which uses Traditional characters (手機, 應用程式, 安裝). The rest of this zh_CN file is Simplified Chinese. zh_CN users will see a Traditional Chinese TOTP instruction.
